correctness.rationale: Verified from Verra's actual primary formula deg gamma=D(g)+2^(g-3), where D(g) is the rank<=3 symmetric quadric locus degree and is explicitly expressed as the same finite binomial product. Exact factorial cancellation yields D(3)=1 and D(g+1)/D(g)=4(2g-3)/g. The sequence 2^(g-3) C_(g-2) has the identical initial value and ratio, proving the all-g identity. Standard Catalan parity formula v2(C_m)=s2(m+1)-1 says C_m odd precisely when m+1 is a 2-power. The odd cases C_(2^r-1) are 1 mod 4 (odd-factorial induction), hence C_m+1 has valuation exactly 1 there and zero otherwise. Independently recomputed Verra product using exact rational binomial arithmetic for every integer 3<=g<=13, and verified exact 2-adic valuations; finite check is corroboration, not the infinite proof.
